recommendationIntro: Recommended values describe regular Auto Khan use; they are guidance and do not change saved settings.

items.label: Open settings
items.description: On the Automation page, select the settings button on the Auto Khan card.

items.label: Attack from
items.description: Choose a Great Empire main castle or outpost that supplies the Khan camp attacks.
items.recommendation: Use an outpost with your attacking army when available.

items.label: Defend at
items.description: Khan retaliations defend at the Great Empire main castle shown here, which is read-only.

items.label: Camp attack preset
items.description: Choose a saved Attack Preset for regular Khan camp attacks.
items.recommendation: Create your regular Khan attack preset first.

items.label: Main defense preset
items.description: Choose a saved Defense Preset reapplied at the main castle before retaliations.
items.recommendation: Create your regular Khan defense preset and prepare its troops and tools.

items.label: Horse travel boost
items.description: Choose feather, coin or ruby travel for camp attacks.
items.recommendation: Travel Feather for fast travel.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Khan castle, preset and travel settings
image.caption: Prepare both presets and main-castle defense before enabling the attack chain.

items.label: Lock automatic Khan attacks
items.description: Stop new camp attacks while rage handling, cooldown work and defense continue.
items.recommendation: Off for regular camp attacks.

items.label: Trigger Khan at full rage
items.description: Provoke a Khan retaliation when rage is full.
items.recommendation: On when the main castle is ready to defend.

items.label: Max rage chain
items.description: Limit accepted retaliations in the current event before new camp attacks stop; 0 removes this limit.
items.recommendation: 0 unless you need a retaliation cap.

items.label: Require Rage points booster
items.description: Allow new automatic camp attacks only while the timed Rage points booster is active.
items.recommendation: Off unless you want booster-only attacks.

items.label: Rage work continues
items.description: A rage-chain cap does not stop full-rage triggering, cooldown work or defense recovery.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Khan rage and attack-permission settings
image.caption: The timed Rage points booster is separate from rage banners.

steps.title: Set score, supply and daily limits

items.label: Stop at Nomad points
items.description: At this reported score, stop new Khan attacks, recall outgoing Khan attacks and open the main gates; 0 disables this stop.
items.recommendation: 0 unless you want to stop and protect at a chosen score.

items.label: Replenish defense tools
items.description: Replace Defense Preset shortages from eligible offers while rejecting ruby-priced packages.
items.recommendation: On if you want eligible automatic purchases.

items.label: Daily normal-attack limit
items.description: Stop this automation’s new camp attacks at the account-wide daily normal-attack count; 0 disables this limit.
items.recommendation: 0 unless you need an account-wide limit.

items.label: Stop before event end
items.description: Stop new camp attacks this many minutes before the event ends.
items.recommendation: 5 minutes.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Khan score, tool and daily-limit settings
image.caption: A positive Nomad-point stop also recalls outgoing Khan attacks and opens main gates.

items.label: Skip every Khan camp cooldown
items.description: Reserve and use enough time-skip items to clear camp cooldowns after attacks.
items.recommendation: On; the current settings dialog requires this to save.

items.label: Keep 1m
items.description: Keep this many 1m time-skip items untouched.
items.recommendation: 0 for regular Khan chains.

items.label: Keep 5m
items.description: Keep this many 5m time-skip items untouched.
items.recommendation: 0 for regular Khan chains.

items.label: Keep 10m
items.description: Keep this many 10m time-skip items untouched.
items.recommendation: 0 for regular Khan chains.

items.label: Keep 30m
items.description: Keep this many 30m time-skip items untouched.
items.recommendation: 0 for regular Khan chains.

items.label: Keep 1h
items.description: Keep this many 1h time-skip items untouched.
items.recommendation: 0 for regular Khan chains.

items.label: Keep 5h
items.description: Keep this many 5h time-skip items untouched.
items.recommendation: Reserve the stock you need for building or other activities.

items.label: Keep 24h
items.description: Keep this many 24h time-skip items untouched.
items.recommendation: Reserve the stock you need for building or other activities.

items.label: Insufficient usable skips
items.description: New camp attacks pause when available time-skip items cannot clear the required cooldown.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Khan cooldown skipping and time-skip reserves
image.caption: Reserve counts are numbers of items, not minutes of time.

items.label: Protect offense on the main-castle wall
items.description: When attacking from the main castle, open its gates and pause Khan if too many offensive troops would defend the wall.
items.recommendation: On when the main castle supplies attacks.

items.label: Offensive wall-unit threshold
items.description: Trigger that main-castle protection when offensive wall units reach this count.
items.recommendation: 1,000 offensive wall units.

items.label: Outpost source
items.description: This wall safeguard is disabled when an outpost supplies attacks and the main castle defends separately.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Khan main-castle wall protection
image.caption: The wall safeguard applies only when the main castle is the attack source.

items.label: Save settings
items.description: Save the selected castles, presets, rage controls, limits, cooldown reserves and protection settings.

items.label: Auto Khan switch
items.description: Enable Auto Khan from its Automation card after checking the main-castle defense.
items.recommendation: On after saving and preparing the defense.

items.label: Auto Station priority
items.description: Auto Station handles incoming player attacks separately from Khan retaliations.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Khan save and enable flow
image.caption: Check the main-castle defense before enabling Khan retaliations.
